items.desc: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
items.readme: agent-browser Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. `snapshot` returns the page as compact text with a ref such as `@e1` for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. Install Homebrew:** `brew install agent-browser`, then `agent-browser install`. Linux:** `agent-browser install --with-deps` also installs the browser's system libraries. items.desc: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
items.readme: MuJoCo** stands for **Mu**lti-**Jo**int dynamics with **Co**ntact. It is a general purpose physics engine that aims to facilitate research and development in robotics, biomechanics, graphics and animation, machine learning, and other areas which demand fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment. This repository is maintained by Google DeepMind. MuJoCo has a C API and is intended for researchers and developers. The runtime simulation module is tuned to maximize performance and operates on low-level data structures that are preallocated by the built-in XML compiler.
